arest.description: AREST engine 0.9.0 — the polyglot engine's verb surface over the apps registry (readings compile to the lfp; status(e) lives on the RMAP columns). 27 first-class verbs: orient / apps_* / query / sql / apply / retract / get / cells / schema / actions / validate / verify / synthesize / explain / compile / propose / induce / ask / context / engine_version. The binding advertises exactly what it dispatches.

arest-legacy.description: The old shell, retained during 0.9.0 interop for the verbs not yet ported: tutor + tutor.* and select_component. WASM mode against its bundled metamodel — the old engine CLI is OUT of the serving path. Everything else: use 'arest' (the new engine).
